before_fix.finding: Not reproducible across checkout locations: 13 absolute source paths (__FILE__ in ggml/PCRE2 assertions) were compiled into the library, so every clone/worktree produced different bytes.

fix: -ffile-prefix-map=<build output>=/quds-spacy-build for PCRE2 and the native library (recorded as file_prefix_map in the build receipt; older receipts are rebuilt, not reused). LC_UUID is kept: ld derives it from the content, so no -no_uuid is needed and dyld loading is unchanged.

ad_hoc_signing.note: The ad hoc identifier is derived from the file name and LC_UUID, so the same unsigned bytes signed as libcrispembed-spacy.dylib give the same result in any directory; re-signing already signed bytes is idempotent. Copies signed under another file name differ.

pinned_artifact.fresh_readback: HTTP 200, 2,322,928 bytes, SHA-256 equal, byte-identical to the qualified file
